info.syllabusName: Quản trị tiếp thị khu vực châu Á (Asian Marketing Management)
info.description:
Basic knowledge of theories of corporate in international marketing
Consumer behavior analysis; objectives establishment; strategy building, marketing communication plan; organizing marketing communication activities; measuring and evaluating the implementation and effectiveness of marketing communication programs.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Apply basic knowledge and theories of corporate to handle actual business activities, marketing communication strategy in Asian market
Analyze external and internal decisions in the Asian market.
Evaluate the effectiveness of marketing strategy, planning, and control programs of firms operating in the Asian market
Establish objectives and budgets for marketing strategy; propose appropriate marketing communication activities for a specific product in the Asian market.
Propose marketing strategy and be able to handle potential problems in the era of globalization and digitalization of the Asian market.
